name: Start Stop Continue

scoring.report_note: Report team-level deltas across cycles only. Never rank teams — the retro measures the team's honesty habits, not facilitation quality.

description: Two-minute pre/post measure for the Start·Stop·Continue retrospective. Scores at team level: how did honesty of feedback, behavior-over-person framing and commitment quality change across the retro?

instructions.pre: Before cards are dealt. Each participant answers alone, about their own last cycle at work — not about the retro.
instructions.post: Immediately after the debrief. Same items, now answered about the retro just completed, as a team.

items.pre_text: I say what is not working while it is still working-ish.
items.post_text: The STOP pile was honest — cards named real problems.

items.pre_text: I describe behaviors, not people, when something goes wrong.
items.post_text: Every card on the wall named a behavior — none named a person.

items.pre_text: I soften feedback until it stops meaning anything.
items.post_text: Some cards were softened until they meant nothing — we caught them.

items.pre_text: Our action items survive the meeting they were born in.
items.post_text: All three commitments passed the one-line test: auditable by anyone.

items.pre_text: We tell each other what is working, not just what is broken.
items.post_text: The CONTINUE pile named things the team wants to protect.

items.pre_text: Retrospectives on this team change something.
items.post_text: This retro ended with three commitments that will be audited.
